scope: Only the exact two new local source/test files below. Read-only dependency inspection and synthetic CPU tests; no source changes. This is not a R15 admission revision, TRAIN execution/deployment admission, full TEST admission, or scientific acceptance.

findings.title: Inherited initialize leaves the preceding sequence's M1 and observer records live

dependency_evidence.observation: Inherited initialize directly calls self.base.initialize, rebuilds anchor/initial_templates and resets last_m2. It does not call self.guard.initialize or clear M1/observer records.
The guard's own initialize normally clears guard.record, but the new subclass bypasses this method.
observer.begin(False) clears calls/record and disables capture without changing predictor ownership.

findings.reproduction: Using the actual M1TemplateGuard and E0Observation with synthetic CPU FakeTracker/FakeE0, first execute a lost-state frame, then call the subclass's inherited initialize with a new initial box. Base frame and since_query become zero, history becomes zero, new sampling is (1,26), and last_m2 resets, but guard.record and guard.observer.record are still the identical previous-sequence objects. Observer enabled/call state is also not reset by initialization.
findings.impact: The initialized new sequence exposes stale failure/probability/template-write and observation evidence from the previous sequence. This violates clean diagnostic sequence boundaries. It does not prove a wrong next-frame gate: guard.track calls observer.begin(True) and overwrites guard.record before recovery_due reads it.
findings.minimal_required_fix: Add a small initialize override that clears guard.record and calls guard.observer.begin(False), then delegates to super().initialize(image, initial_box). Preserve the installed observer and perform the base initialization and identity anchor construction exactly once; do not call both guard.initialize and super().initialize.
findings.required_verification: Add a synthetic CPU lifecycle regression covering a real guard/observer, one tracked frame followed by a second sequence initialization. Assert record=None, observer.record=None, observer.calls=0, observer.enabled=False, base counters/history reset, anchor/templates/last_m2 reset, and one initialization. Verify first track of the new sequence uses a fresh M1 record and close restores the original predictor.

constructor_and_initial_observer.evidence: Parent construction creates direct E0 and loads M2. The guard is then installed on that direct base model. E0Observation starts disabled with no record/calls. Parent initialization uses crop/encode for the identity anchor, not model.predict, so installing the observer before the first initialize does not create an extra E0 prediction or an M1 classification.
constructor_and_initial_observer.limits: Actual constructor checkpoint load, CUDA transfer and real encoder initialization were not executed. The lifecycle probe uses the real guard/observer with synthetic base and stubs initialization crop/anchor operations.

gate_and_sampling.evidence: One guard.track calls direct E0 once and produces the current M1 record before gating. Recovery requires state==2 and membership in the inherited sampled-frame tuple. Previous box is captured before E0; candidate generation receives that previous box and initial templates. M1 runs every tracked frame while candidates run only at the intersection of lost and existing cadence.
gate_and_sampling.limits: With a consecutive full-style valid list, inherited sampling is 1,26,51,... . Irregular TRAIN valid lists can intersect divisible-by5 template-write frames. The forced CPU frame5 probe exercises that intersection; it is not a full TEST execution.

non_recovery.evidence: Returns the exact guard box and route objects and marks last_m2 not invoked. This preserves guarded E0, including deliberate M1 rollback of uncertain/lost template writes, rather than claiming equality to unguarded E0 templates.

no_match.evidence: Index0 retains the guarded E0 box, route, history, query counter and templates. Actual M1 guard rollback remains in force. It records invoked=true and class_index=0.

positive_replacement.evidence: Only state/history are changed after guarded E0. No replacement crop or template write is present. When lost E0 proposes a template write, M1 has already rolled it back; the synthetic frame5 probes verify that neither no-match nor positive replacement reintroduces it. Returned positive box is copied from the selected candidate and the E0 route object is retained.

since_query_and_frame.evidence: The base alone increments frame and updates since_query once. Positive replacement preserves the resulting counter; E0 action1 already reset it and action0 already incremented it. Omitting R15's redundant action1 reset is correct. History uses that final counter/100 with replacement movement and log size change relative to the pre-E0 previous box.

history_confidence.evidence: Replacement history retains the same-frame pre-replacement E0 modality/confidence while using replacement geometry. Candidate logits are not substituted for calibrated E0 confidence. This deliberately retains R15's mixed-provenance contract; its causal effect and an alternative contract require separate TRAIN evidence. The new class must not be described as having solved confidence/history attribution.

timing.evidence: Returned route.seconds comes from direct E0 and excludes subsequent M1 classification/rollback and M2 candidate/head/history work. Inherited initialize returns direct E0 initialization time and excludes identity-anchor work. This matches inherited return semantics; it is not total gated-tracker latency.
timing.required_future_runner_contract: A separately reviewed runner must measure around complete initialize/track calls with appropriate synchronization and explicit decode scope, as the R15 evaluator does, rather than summing route.seconds or inherited initialize's return. No new runner was supplied or admitted here.

close.evidence: Delegates to guard.close, which restores the original model.predict. Verified with the actual observer, beyond the supplied Mock delegation test.

parameter_and_checkpoint_boundary.evidence: M2 checkpoint loading/freeze is inherited. M1 head, mean and scale are injected by the caller; this class does not itself establish their parent/checkpoint identity or frozen/eval state. Future integration should reuse load_reliability and bind exact M1/M2/E0 identities and normalization. No new defensive layer is requested for this dependency-injected class.

supplied_cpu_tests.scope: Gate truth table; non-recovery exact returned-object preservation using mocked guard; close delegation using mocked guard.
supplied_cpu_tests.coverage_limits: Tests do not construct the real subclass/observer, initialize/reset two sequences, enter positive/no-match candidate branches, verify since_query/history/templates, or establish total timing.

checks: Actual M1TemplateGuard and E0Observation on existing synthetic FakeTracker/FakeE0
One candidate invocation and pre-E0 previous box binding
Forced divisible-by5 lost-state template write rollback retained through no-match and positive branches
Frame and query counters, replacement motion/log-size/history, and no-match guarded history preservation
Inherited initialization resets base state/counters/history and last_m2 but retains previous guard/observer records
reviewer_synthetic_cpu_probes.stubs: Candidate arrays/head logits are synthetic; Tensor.cuda is temporarily an identity operation on CPU; initialization crop/anchor and base initialization are stubbed. No real network forward, encoder, checkpoint, optimizer, GPU or dataset execution.
reviewer_synthetic_cpu_probes.probe_harness_note: First probe attempt stopped due to unittest.mock call-argument introspection in the temporary harness. Correcting the harness to call_args[0] allowed all four branch cases and lifecycle checks to complete; no reviewed source was changed.

recommended_test_additions: Two-sequence lifecycle reset with actual guard/observer, including the blocking defect above
Persist CPU positive/no-match branch regressions covering action0/action1, history/counters and forced template rollback
Assert candidate generator/head are not called for reliable, uncertain or off-cadence lost frames; current non-recovery tests infer early return but do not mock and assert those call boundaries
Verify any future runner's total timing scope separately; these class tests cannot establish performance or improvement

minimal_next_step: Report-only: clear M1/observer diagnostic state in a small subclass initialize override and add the sequence-reset regression, then request a fresh exact-hash review. No code was edited. The remaining history/timing limitations must remain explicit; they are not scientific or benchmark acceptance.

preserved_context.R15_cadence_qualification: Consecutive full TEST sampling calls M2 on 1+25k, all frame%5==1; R15 replacement-template frame%5==0 branch is dormant. Old confidence still enters replacement history; later normal E0 writes are separate.

claim_ceiling: SOURCE_FAIL for one reproduced cross-sequence diagnostic-state reset defect in the exact two-file candidate. Core gate/no-match/positive mutation logic passed synthetic CPU probes, with explicitly limited coverage. No TRAIN execution, deployment, full TEST admission, model improvement, Astra attribution or scientific acceptance.
